name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted Habitica habit tracker that turns tasks and goals into a role-playing game, with a MongoDB replica set for storage.

alerts.message: The first account registered becomes the administrator. Register it right after deployment, then set INVITE_ONLY to true to stop open sign-ups.

Password reset and invitation emails need an SMTP server: set EMAIL_SERVER_URL, EMAIL_SERVER_PORT, EMAIL_SERVER_AUTH_USER, EMAIL_SERVER_AUTH_PASSWORD and ADMIN_EMAIL (the sender address). Only plain or STARTTLS ports such as 587 work, not implicit TLS on 465.
MongoDB needs a CPU with AVX support on x86_64 servers.
